name: slim-sheet
description: Universal, token-frugal spreadsheet MCP server and CLI for any agent, from local 7B models to frontier models.
long_description: Reads xlsx, xls, xlsb, ods, Numbers, csv, parquet and json locally. Token-budgeted output, SQL over sheets, cleaning, anomaly detection, a formula copilot and Excel-correct editing. Edits go to a .slim copy unless you allow overwriting, and every change can be undone.

tools.name: overview
tools.description: Map a spreadsheet file (or list the spreadsheets in a folder; no path lists all allowed folders): sheets, used ranges, header row, columns and types. Call this first.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read cells as a table with A1 coordinates (sheet, range 'A1:F50', cursor). sheet='#vba' lists macros; range='Module1' shows its code.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find cells containing text (or a regex) across sheets; returns Sheet!A1 addresses. Example: find(path='sales.xlsx', text='refund')

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run one read-only SQL SELECT; tables are sheet names, quote names with spaces. Example: sql='SELECT "Region", sum("Total") FROM "Orders" GROUP BY 1'

tools.name: profile
tools.description: Column statistics for a sheet: type, nulls, distinct, min, max, mean, median, top values. Optional columns list.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write a 2-D values array starting at range's top-left cell, e.g. values=[['Total', 120]]. Saves to <name>.slim.xlsx unless overwrite=true.

tools.name: explain_formula
tools.description: Explain and check an Excel formula: steps, references, syntax/arity errors. Pass formula='=...' or path plus cell like 'Sheet1!C7'.

tools.name: build_report
tools.description: Build a branded dashboard sheet from a data sheet in one call. Example: kpis=['Revenue=sum:Total','Orders=count'], charts=['trend:Month:Total']

tools.name: clean
tools.description: Clean a table: ops from trim, collapse_spaces, remove_nonprintable, unify_null, numbers_from_text, normalize_dates, drop_empty_rows, drop_empty_cols, dedupe. Previews unless apply=true.

tools.name: anomalies
tools.description: Find suspicious cells (duplicates, types, outliers, typos); scope='formulas' audits models; scope='macros' rates VBA risks (auto-run, Shell, downloads).

tools.name: merge
tools.description: Join two tables on keys (how=left|inner|full|anti), or how=reconcile to label rows matched/different/only_left/only_right. keys=['ID'] or ['ID=Order No'].

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert to xlsx/csv/tsv/parquet/json by out_path extension; CSV: delimiter=';', encoding='cp1252', decimal=','. split_by='Region' splits; a folder exports VBA.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare two files cell by cell, or row by row with key='ID'. Example: diff(path='a.xlsx', other_path='a.slim.xlsx')

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last slim-sheet write to a file (every editing tool is journaled).

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Calculate a formula offline, or check it with check_only=true (target='2016'). Example: evaluate(path='x.xlsx', cell='Calc!C7')

tools.name: describe_cell
tools.description: Everything about one cell: value, formula, format, note, validation; trace='precedents' or 'dependents' follows formulas across sheets.

tools.name: style_sheet
tools.description: Make a table look professional in one call: header, number formats (auto), totals, widths, freeze. preset=report|data|finance|striped|minimal.

tools.name: what_if
tools.description: Change inputs in memory and see outputs move: op=delta|goal_seek|grid. Example: inputs=['Inputs!B3=8%'], outputs=['Model!B20']. Never writes.

tools.name: create_workbook
tools.description: Create a new empty branded .xlsx with the given sheet names. Example: create_workbook(path='out.xlsx', sheets=['Data','Summary'])

tools.name: sheet_ops
tools.description: Add, rename, delete, copy, move, hide or unhide a sheet (op=...). Renames also fix formulas that point to the sheet.

tools.name: range_ops
tools.description: Edit a block: op=fill|copy|move|transpose|sort|replace|insert|delete|clear|split. Example: op='fill', range='D2:D200'. where="Status='Closed'" filters rows.

tools.name: name_ops
tools.description: List, add or delete defined names. Example: name_ops(path, op='add', name='TaxRate', ref='Rates!B2')

tools.name: format_range
tools.description: Style a range: role ('title','header','total'...), bold, colors, number_format ('percent','m'...), align, border, merge, autofit.

tools.name: set_table
tools.description: Turn a range with a header row into a named Excel table; same name again resizes it. Example: set_table(path, sheet='Data', range='A1:D50', name='Sales', totals=true)

tools.name: rules
tools.description: Add a dropdown/input rule (kind=list|whole|decimal|date|text_length|custom) or highlight rule (greater_than|between|duplicates|top_n|color_scale|data_bar|formula...).

tools.name: add_chart
tools.description: Insert a clean branded chart (type=auto picks one) from data_range: header row + category column + series columns. Optional highlight='North'; replace=true swaps the chart at anchor.

tools.name: pivot
tools.description: Summarise a table: rows=['Region'], values=['Total'], agg=sum|count|avg|min|max, columns='Month'. to_sheet saves it; native=true makes a real Excel PivotTable.

tools.name: recalc
tools.description: Recalculate every formula with LibreOffice so cached values are fresh (needs LibreOffice installed).

tools.name: sheet_layout
tools.description: Set how a sheet looks and prints: freeze, widths=['A=14'], heights, filter_range, hide, gridlines, zoom, print_area, landscape, fit_width, protect; workbook: calc_mode, protect_structure.

tools.name: annotate
tools.description: Add a note, hyperlink or image to a cell, or remove objects: op=note|link|image|remove. Example: op='link', cell='B2', url='https://...'

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.description: Folder with the spreadsheets slim-sheet may read and write

tier.title: Tool tier
tier.description: full (28 tools, default), standard (16) or lite (7, small models)
